title: Simulation relation
statement: Let $g$ and $d$ be configurations as in the track relation, and fix a program node and a call specification with its register-word assignment. They are related for simulation if there exist a decider state $q$, a segment index $s$, Boolean parity and direction values, and a track position $t$ such that $g$ is in the corresponding simulation state, carrying the first bit of $d$'s output when present, $d$ is in state $q$, and the two configurations satisfy the track relation at those parameters.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration c₀ with m work tapes and input x
A call specification and register-word assignment W
A configuration g with m+k_D work tapes on x
A configuration d with k_D work tapes on the virtual call input
caveat: The track relation's detailed position conventions depend on omitted definitions.
